name: Glaskunst-Workshop in Kramsach
beschreibung:
=== description ===
In the glassworks of **Kramsach**, one of Tirol’s oldest glass factories, you can become a glassblower yourself. Under the guidance of a master, you’ll craft your own unique piece: a colorful vase, delicate Christmas ornament, or a drinking cup. A truly special fire experience that brings ancient craftsmanship to life.
